description: Halo: Combat Evolved, recompiled from the decompiled Xbox game (needs your own Xbox disc image)
notes: OpenH1 needs your own Xbox disc image of Halo: Combat Evolved: at its first start the game asks for it
and copies its maps folder out of it (about 2 GB). See https://openh1.com.
Your settings, maps, Custom Edition maps, mods and screenshots are kept in $persist_dir;
saved games are in %APPDATA%\halo. Scoop updates the game (scoop update openh1),
so its own updater is off (update.auto = false in config.toml).
pre_install: # Scoop updates the game, so it does not update itself (the game's update.auto)
Set-Content -LiteralPath "$dir\config.toml" -Encoding Ascii -Value @('[update]', '# Scoop updates OpenH1 (scoop update openh1), so the game does not update itself.', 'auto = false')
# (persisted files must exist before they are persisted, or Scoop makes them folders)
post_install: # No maps kept yet: the empty maps folder Scoop made would stop the game's first start from offering
# to copy them out of the disc image, so it is taken away; pre_uninstall keeps the folder the game makes.
pre_uninstall: # The maps folder the game copied out of the disc image, kept with the player's other files
# before an update or an uninstall (the next version links it back in)
